observations.title: Build a rideable Create swing
observations.player_action: Consult the mod's included Ponder presentation when constructing a swing structure.
observations.outcome: The author describes freely shaped swing structures that can be ridden.

observations.title: Assemble a double-rope swing
observations.player_action: Place equal-height rope anchors and connect the lower ends with seat blocks.
observations.outcome: The native Ponder guide describes automatic swing formation; its scene demonstrates a multi-block seat between two rope columns.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Native Ponder text/scenes document assembly and controls, not a server quest criterion. An adapter would need the real assembled swing/rider state; inventory possession alone does not prove assembly or riding. Branch1.20.1 is not asserted identical to installed0.1.0.

observations.title: Control a ridden swing
observations.player_action: While riding, use forward to increase the swing and backward to reduce it; dismount with timing.
observations.outcome: The native guide documents increased/decreased motion and momentum-based launch on a well-timed dismount. A mob occupant also starts swinging.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
